title: TractEasy Internship
summary: Field service on autonomous electric tow tractors, plus two internal tools: a deployment tracker and an AI-assisted onboarding guide.
problem: Deploying a vehicle is a lot for a new field service engineer. Beyond technical skill it takes documentation, strict timelines and organization, and shadowing alone doesn’t teach all of that.
approach: I built Flown, a Python and PyQt6 desktop tool that combines a node-based deployment flowchart, a Gantt chart, a progress tracker, an instructional guide and a document generator. I also used the company’s AI tools to build an interactive onboarding and training resource from approved documentation.
result: Engineers who tried Flown said it would have helped during their own onboarding and that they’d prefer it to a shared document. In the field I diagnosed and resolved hardware, software and integration issues and coordinated deployments with site managers.
